source.statement: For every lambda>0 and epsilon>0, output x with ||Ax-b||_2^2 + lambda||x||_1 <= (1+epsilon) min_x (||Ax-b||_2^2 + ||x||_1).

falsification_condition: The minimum possible left side exceeds the stated right side, so no output x exists.
negative_control: Setting lambda=1 makes both objectives identical and x=1/2 satisfies the stated 1+epsilon guarantee.
